name: Intergalactic Ball · Shared Ball (cloister)
notes: Ancient Spanish Monastery cloister: the open courtyard is the dance floor, the booth in the corner, galleries all round. Built from the Cloister Tuning Map, designed by Uzo Udu. TuneiT Space does not model the arcade columns between the courtyard and the galleries; the map takes 6 to 12 dB off for them, so gallery levels read higher in TuneiT Space. Towers and lights are listed in the speaker notes only. Layouts with a tent: the Rumbas clear-top frame tent is drawn on the tuning map only; TuneiT Space has no roof model, so expect slightly more level and reflection under the tent than TuneiT Space shows.
